what_this_is: Each desk odds row split by the side of its trades, and beside each trend row the same stop and hold taken long (and short) on every free session. A two-sided row (two_sided_behaviours) pools long and short trades; this file gives each side its own count, win share, mean R after costs, t and both halves. Evidence for the analyst, not a rule.
how_measured: The census's own one-at-a-time trade list for each market and behaviour, on the table's named history source, window, cost in normal days, warmup and half split; each trade keeps the side it was taken on. The two sides of a row add back to the table's row exactly (checked per market). Always-in: the behaviour's stop, target, hold and trailing, entered at the next open after every free session (one trade at a time), after the same cost. win_share counts trades above 0R after cost.
